op nushe.openProfileSubject: Invitation for {First Name} to the Executive Leaders Dinner Roundtable in Dallas, April 29th
op nushe.openProfileBody:
Hi {First Name}, I  hope you are having a lovely day.

This is {senderFirstName} from The Ortus Club.

I'm reaching out to ask for your availability to join our upcoming Dinner Roundtable happening on the 29th of April at 6:00 PM CDT for Senior Leaders in Dallas.

The discussion will focus on "Composable, Not Complicated: Making Headless DXPs Work at Enterprise Scale".

Given your role and experience, we were very much hoping you would be able to join us. We think you would find the discussion very interesting, network with other senior leaders, and share insights on the pressing challenges within the industry, particularly around balancing developer agility with enterprise reliability in composable architectures.

Here, you can find all the information on the event, and also register to save your spot right away:

https://www.ortusclub.com/event/composable-not-complicated-dal/

This is an invitation-only event.

We would be delighted to have you join us and hope to receive confirmation of your attendance.
Would you be able to join us on the 29th of April in Dallas?

Best wishes,

{senderName}

PS: I'd love to jump on a quick 10-minute call and connect more—happy to share additional details about the evening and the leaders attending.
